projects.name: AtelierOS
projects.description: A fashion house management platform designed to bring client records, body measurements, orders, production activity and inventory into one operating system.
projects.summary: AtelierOS is being developed to help fashion businesses coordinate the operational work behind each customer order, from client records and measurements through production and inventory.
projects.problem: Fashion businesses can manage customer information, measurements, orders, production tasks and stock across separate notebooks, spreadsheets and messaging threads. This makes it harder to maintain a clear view of work in progress and accountability.
projects.purpose: Create a connected workspace for fashion houses to manage day-to-day operations and give owners and managers clearer oversight.
goals: Bring client profiles and measurement records into one place.
Connect customer orders to production workflows.
Support inventory visibility and stock allocation.
Give owners and managers oversight of staff activity and operational records.
projects.solution: A multi-role fashion business management platform with connected client, order, production and inventory workflows.
projects.role: Product direction, operations workflow definition and project coordination.
projects.outcome: The product scope and core operating workflows have been defined and are being implemented. A pilot approach is planned. No quantified business impact is being claimed at this stage.
projects.contribution: Defined operational requirements and workflows for the fashion-house use case, including role responsibilities and production processes.
projects.lessons: The product is being shaped around the actual sequence of work in a fashion house, rather than treating customer records, production and inventory as disconnected features.

projects.name: Sowvera
projects.description: A fashion academy operating system concept connecting admissions, students, programmes, instructors, lessons, practical projects and administration.
projects.summary: Sowvera is being developed as a management platform for fashion schools and academies, bringing academic administration and practical training activity into a connected system.
projects.problem: Fashion schools need to coordinate admissions, student records, programmes, instructors, schedules, attendance, assessments, fees and certificates. Managing these activities separately can make administration and reporting difficult.
projects.purpose: Provide fashion schools with a central operating workspace for managing the student journey and academy operations.
goals: Track lessons, attendance and practical projects.
Support assessments, fees, certificates and reporting.
projects.solution: A multi-tenant SaaS platform planned around the administrative and learning workflows of fashion academies.
projects.role: Product concept development, operational requirements and project direction.
projects.outcome: Product requirements and platform direction have been outlined. Implementation is in progress; no adoption or performance figures are being claimed.
projects.contribution: Mapped the operational needs of fashion education providers into a proposed digital product structure.
projects.lessons: Fashion education combines academic administration with practical, project-based learning. Both sides need to be represented in the operating model.

projects.name: OptiFlow Ops Solutions
projects.description: An operations-focused business working across process improvement, HR operations, project coordination and practical digital solutions.
projects.summary: OptiFlow Ops Solutions is the umbrella business through which operations support, business systems and digital solutions are developed and delivered.
projects.problem: Growing businesses often need clearer operating processes and dependable digital foundations, but may not have the internal capacity to organise these areas.
projects.purpose: Support organisations with practical operations improvement and accessible digital business solutions.
goals: Improve clarity around business processes and responsibilities.
Help businesses establish practical digital infrastructure.
projects.solution: An operations and business systems service model supported by digital products and implementation services.
features: Website and professional email setup services
projects.outcome: OptiFlow is active as the umbrella business. Specific client engagements and quantified outcomes will be added as they are verified.
projects.contribution: Developing the service direction and connecting operational needs with practical business systems.
projects.lessons: Digital tools create value when they support a clear operating process and a defined business need.
